content.title: What Time Does Justin Bieber Perform At Coachella Today? Everything You Need To Know To Livestream Coachella
content.text: Published April 11, 2026, 3:00 p.m. ET Decider Streamline: 'Euphoria' Season 3 on HBO Max, 'The Boys' Season 5 on Prime Video and More0 seconds of 59 secondsVolume 0% Justin Bieber will be making a major comeback tonight when he graces the Coachella as a headliner for the very first time. After Sabrina Carpenter smashed night one of Coachella 2026 with her “most ambitious” performance yet, the “Daisies” singer will be the second headliner to take Coachella Stage. And it looks like his setlist may have been leaked. Love Island USA star Nic Vansteenberghe shared the setlist on Threads writing it’s the “rumor going around town.” Vansteenberghe claimed the setlist includes “Sorry,” a cover of Ne-Yo’s “So Sick,” as well as his other hits “One Less Lonely Girl,” “Beauty and a Beat” and more. Bieber won’t be performing alone Saturday. The Saturday Coachella lineup features several major names. Jack White will be kicking off the day with a 4 p.m. PDT performance on the Mojave Stage, followed by performances from Addison Rae, Labrinth, David Byrne and Geese. The Strokes will also take the Coachella Stage ahead of Bieber’s performance at 9:00 p.m. EDT. Next up, Karol G will round out the first weekend of Coachella 2026 Sunday evening. The Colombian singer will make history as the first Latina to headline the music festival. Visit Advertiser websiteGO TO PAGEBut you don’t have to be in the desert to get to catch Bieber’s set. Here is everything you need to know to livestream Coachella from home. When does Justin Bieber perform at Coachella? Photo: Joseph Okpako/WireImage Justin Bieber is performing at Coachella Saturday April 11 at 11:25 p.m. PDT. Fans who couldn’t make it to the sold-out festival can tune in from home via the Coachella livestream. Coachella will be live streaming every performance from every single stage this weekend on the Coachella YouTube page and the Coachella app. Some of the performances will be available in 4K. Viewers will also be able to stream four separate performances at the same time on YouTube in a new 4×4 grid format. Bieber will return to the Coachella stage to headline again next weekend, April 17-19. Tags Justin Bieber YouTube
